performance.verdict: SOW is 67+ days overdue; no campaigns are actually live yet.

findings.text: 5 of 10 SOW milestones were due 2026-07-31 — stack test, GHL migration, GBP triage, Meta account/CAPI, and landing pages — none completed; Phase 1 is blocked.
3 further milestones due 2026-08-31–09-01 (Meta lanes, Search campaigns, LSA, nurture sequences) and Phase 1 close due 2026-09-30 are also unresolved.
CPL spiked +106.64% (7d vs prior 7d) while leads rose only +16%; spend surged +139.7%, meaning efficiency broke sharply as budget scaled.
3-day signal (Oct 3–5): leads = 6, 0, 2 vs prior 3 days (Sep 30–Oct 2): 6, 9, 2. Lead volume flat-to-declining while daily spend averaged ~$41.64 — efficiency not recovering.
GHL pipeline is null across 28 days; 127 Meta leads have no corresponding pipeline data — intake routing is unverifiable and may be an ops leak, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 10 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer and Sohib immediately; no scaling until stack test and tracking are verified.
suggestions.monday_update: Ten SOW milestones are overdue, the earliest by 67 days (2026-07-31). Pre-launch stack test, GHL migration, Meta CAPI, landing pages, and tracking have not been confirmed complete, meaning attribution and intake are unverified. Sohib should flag this to Nacer and Mateus immediately and obtain a revised delivery date for each item. Success is written confirmation of completion dates for all 10 milestones by 2026-10-10.

suggestions.text: Cut MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP daily budget ~20% to reduce CPL bleed while milestones remain unresolved.
suggestions.monday_update: CPL jumped +106.64% while spend surged +139.7% and leads grew only +16% over the last 7 days. The 3-day signal (Oct 3–5) shows 8 leads on ~$124.92 spend versus 17 leads in the prior 3 days on comparable spend — efficiency is not recovering. Reduce the MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP daily budget by approximately 20% from its current run rate (~$45/day to ~$36/day). Confirm CPL is back below the 28-day baseline of $6.19 within 5 days (by 2026-10-11).

suggestions.text: Watch GHL pipeline for lead-to-opportunity conversion; re-check 2026-10-09 — 127 leads with null pipeline is unresolved.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL pipeline data is null across the full 28-day window despite 127 Meta leads being recorded. This could mean leads are not routing into GHL at all, or the integration is not reporting. No action on ad spend is warranted until this is ruled out as an intake problem. Re-check on 2026-10-09; if pipeline still reads null, escalate as a CRM fix before any further scaling.
